notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
We are happy to announce certain bug fixes and changes have been implemented.

1. [b]Leaderboards [/b]now work
2. Achievements for dodging now are [b]30[/b] and [b]70 [/b]respectively. Reduced from 100 and 500
3. Point system was too lenient, now 3 points per character collision 

Happy gaming :)
